name: Radio
description: Single radio option with a custom dot. Standalone with v-model, or declare only `value` inside a Radio Group.

props.name: modelValue
props.description: Standalone value (v-model). Ignored inside a group.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Blocks selection; inherited from the group.

props.name: size
props.description: Dot size; inherited from the group or form item.

props.name: name
props.description: Native radio name; inherited from the group.

events.name: change
events.description: Emitted with the value when selected.

example:
<s-radio-group v-model="channel" inline>
  <s-radio value="direct">Direct</s-radio>
  <s-radio value="marketplace">Marketplace</s-radio>
  <s-radio value="partner" disabled>Partner</s-radio>
</s-radio-group>
